description:
Clean Architecture Solution Template for .NET 9 with essential features ready to use out of the box.

      ✅ Layered architecture following Clean Architecture principles
      ✅ CQRS with MediatR implementation
      ✅ Entity Framework Core with SQL Server support
      ✅ API with OpenAPI/Swagger documentation
      ✅ Built-in validation using FluentValidation
      ✅ Docker and Docker Compose support
      ✅ Automated testing with xUnit
      ✅ Logging and exception handling infrastructure
releaseNotes:
v1.0.1:
      - Initial release with core Clean Architecture structure
      - Support for .NET 9
      - Docker and Docker Compose integration
      - Full MediatR CQRS implementation
      - Entity Framework Core with SQL Server
summary: Production-ready template based on Clean Architecture principles for developing modern .NET applications with support for CQRS, EF Core, and best practices.
title: Clean Architecture Solution Template
